d: Catch all goals and match highlights from Uzbekistan vs Jamaica in Group E of the FIFA U-17 World Cup Qatar 2026. Uzbekistan took a 6-2 group stage win at Aspire Zone in Doha with goals from Laziz Abduraimov, a Sukhrob Sadirjanov hat-trick, Amirkhon Erkinov, and Akhrorbek Ravshanbekov, while Kelvin Brown netted twice for Jamaica.
